_about: Reviews from places the daily job cannot read (Trustpilot has no free feed). Add one by hand: leader key, the HQ tab of the trip it was about, who wrote it, where, when, the full text and the link.

reviews.text:
Having now completed six Surf Yoga Beer trips, Côte d’Azur is definitely in the running for my favorite. The South of France is an incredible destination, but what really put this trip over the top for me was the combination of exceptional leadership, a fantastic group of people, and the amount of care that clearly went into every detail. From the itinerary and activities to the restaurants, accommodations, and overall atmosphere, everything felt thoughtfully planned.

One of the things I appreciate most about Surf Yoga Beer is that they give you everything you need to have an incredible trip—the itinerary, the destinations, the activities, and countless opportunities to connect with great people—but they also give you the freedom to experience it however you want. You can join every activity, spend an afternoon exploring on your own, or do a little of both. The Côte d’Azur trip struck that balance perfectly, and I think that’s one of the things that makes Surf Yoga Beer stand out.

I had only met one person before this trip, so I showed up knowing almost no one. By the end of the week, I left with 26 friends. That’s something I’ll always be grateful for. It says a lot about the people on the trip, the atmosphere that was created, and the kind of experience Surf Yoga Beer strives to create.

Everything was exceptionally well organized. Communication was clear, logistics ran smoothly, and I never found myself wondering what was happening next. Moving a group through multiple cities and activities isn’t easy, but the entire trip felt effortless from our perspective.

Erin, Holly, Christian, and Matas were an outstanding leadership team. They were approachable, organized, professional, and genuinely invested in making sure everyone had a great experience. They struck the perfect balance of keeping everything running smoothly while still making the trip feel relaxed and fun. They’re easily among my favorite Surf Yoga Beer leaders, and I’d happily do another trip with any of them. And a special shout-out to Erin for putting together an absolutely baller day at Shellona Saint-Tropez. It was easily one of the highlights of the week.

The food, accommodations, and activities were all excellent, and every stop felt intentional. Nothing felt like it was included just to fill the itinerary.

This trip reminded me why I keep coming back to Surf Yoga Beer. Yes, the destinations are incredible, but what keeps me booking these trips are the people you meet, the experiences you share, and the friendships you come home with. If you’re considering this trip—whether you’re traveling solo or with friends—I couldn’t recommend it more highly.
